# Task Plan: SDC Test Randomization Hardening (数值/地址空间变异加固)

## Goal
Audit all SDC detection tests for insufficient operand-value and address-space variation, identify hardening points, and produce an implementation plan for randomization hardening (value randomization + address-space coverage e.g. large malloc, offset randomization) that improves SDC detection coverage without breaking golden-value reproducibility.

## Next Step
Phase 1: enumerate all test groups and audit their operand/address-space variation characteristics (delegate parallel audit agents per test directory).

## Current Phase
Phase 1

## Phases

### Phase 1: Test Audit (operand/address-space variation census)
- [ ] Enumerate all test groups (arithmetic, fma, eigen_*, ipsec, zstd, zlib, sleef, openblas, pocketfft, isa-l, memory, cache, vector, sve, etc.)
- [ ] For each group: how are operands generated? (constant / fixed pattern / RNG per-thread / RNG per-run)
- [ ] For each group: how is memory allocated? (static / stack / fixed malloc / sized malloc; single buffer vs multiple; offset randomization?)
- [ ] Classify: which tests use random_input/randbits vs hardcoded constants
- [ ] Check memory tests (memory/, cache/) for address-space coverage strategy
- [ ] Document in findings.md (per-test table)
- **Status:** in_progress

### Phase 2: Framework capability survey
- [ ] RNG facilities: random_input/randbits/random.cpp APIs, per-thread state, re-seeding per iteration
- [ ] Memory allocation helpers: existing malloc wrappers, page-aligned alloc, hugepage support
- [ ] How golden-value comparison constrains randomization (memcmp reproducibility rule)
- [ ] Existing knobs: --datasize-style per-test knobs, test-specific env vars
- [ ] mmap/madvise/THP availability on the host
- **Status:** pending

### Phase 3: Gap analysis & hardening-point identification
- [ ] Rank tests by (fixed operands, fixed addresses, small working set) — worst SDC coverage first
- [ ] For each hardening point: which randomization technique applies (operand re-roll per iteration, buffer offset randomization, multi-buffer stride, large-malloc sparse sweep, alignment variation)
- [ ] Identify tests where randomization breaks golden values (crypto hashes need fixed input→output; re-roll strategy must be compatible)
- [ ] Cross-reference 122-CPU SDC hunt mission context (memory/cpu122-sdc-hunt-mission.md)
- **Status:** pending

### Phase 4: Plan formulation
- [ ] Design common randomization helpers (if framework-level) vs per-test changes
- [ ] One-patch-per-unit decomposition matching CLAUDE.md patch discipline
- [ ] Verification strategy per unit (build + run + regression + x86 non-regression)
- [ ] Write final plan doc to docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-19-*.md
- **Status:** pending

### Phase 5: Delivery
- [ ] Present audit table + hardening points + plan to user
- [ ] Get approval / feedback
- **Status:** pending

## Decisions Made

===END-PWF-DATA kind=plan nonce=1545f9866a01d48554165a16===

- superpowers:dispatching-parallel-agents: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies
- superpowers:executing-plans: Use when you have a written implementation plan to execute in a separate session with review checkpoints
- superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch: Use when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work
- superpowers:receiving-code-review: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation
- superpowers:requesting-code-review: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements
- superpowers:subagent-driven-development: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session
- superpowers:systematic-debugging: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
- superpowers:test-driven-development: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code
- superpowers:using-git-worktrees: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback
- superpowers:using-superpowers: Use when starting any conversation - establishes how to find and use skills, requiring skill invocation before ANY response including clarifying questions
- superpowers:verification-before-completion: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always
- superpowers:writing-plans: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code
- superpowers:writing-skills: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- verify: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by running the app and observing behavior. Use when asked to verify a PR, confirm a fix works, test a change manually, check that a feature works, or validate local changes before pushing.
- code-review: Review the current diff for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings). Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

- review: Review a GitHub pull request; for your working diff use /code-review
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

**活动任务（2026-09-19 起，高优先级）**：这台机器 CPU **122 号核心存在 SDC 故障**（唯一故障核心，其余核全部正常）。任务：写出能**快速检出 122** 的测试用例（放 `tests/cpu/sve/`）+ 分析**什么负载最快触发**它。

**强制两阶段验证流程**（每次新写/改写测试用例都必须执行）：
1. 热插拔 offline 122（`echo 0 > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu122/online`）
2. 其余全核跑 60s：逻辑正确的代码**必须 100% pass 零 fail**——任何 fail 都是我的测试代码 bug，必须修复，不许归咎硬件
3. online 122（`echo 1 > .../online`）
4. 全核（含 122）跑：fail 必须精确锁定在 cpu 122 才证明测试有效

**Why:** 用户明确设定此流程为任务纪律（干净基线证明代码正确性，全核运行证明测试有效性）；相关纲领在 `docs/docs_xu/2026-09-19-cpu122-sdc-hunt-mission.md`。

**How to apply:** 在 sdcshield 仓库做任何 SVE/新测试开发时，先读任务纲领文档；每次验证都走 offline 122 → 60s 基线 → online 122 → 全核判定 四步；测试若在 60s 基线出 fail 先修自己的代码。相关：[[research-docs-location]]。

# Task Plan: SDC Test Randomization Hardening (数值/地址空间变异加固)

## Goal
Audit all SDC detection tests for insufficient operand-value and address-space variation, identify hardening points, and produce an implementation plan for randomization hardening (value randomization + address-space coverage e.g. large malloc, offset randomization) that improves SDC detection coverage without breaking golden-value reproducibility.

## Next Step
Phase 1: enumerate all test groups and audit their operand/address-space variation characteristics (delegate parallel audit agents per test directory).

## Current Phase
Phase 1

- [ ] Enumerate all test groups (arithmetic, fma, eigen_*, ipsec, zstd, zlib, sleef, openblas, pocketfft, isa-l, memory, cache, vector, sve, etc.)
- [ ] For each group: how are operands generated? (constant / fixed pattern / RNG per-thread / RNG per-run)
- [ ] For each group: how is memory allocated? (static / stack / fixed malloc / sized malloc; single buffer vs multiple; offset randomization?)
- [ ] Classify: which tests use random_input/randbits vs hardcoded constants
- [ ] Check memory tests (memory/, cache/) for address-space coverage strategy
- [ ] Document in findings.md (per-test table)
- **Status:** in_progress

### Phase 2: Framework capability survey
- [ ] RNG facilities: random_input/randbits/random.cpp APIs, per-thread state, re-seeding per iteration
- [ ] Memory allocation helpers: existing malloc wrappers, page-aligned alloc, hugepage support
- [ ] How golden-value comparison constrains randomization (memcmp reproducibility rule)
- [ ] Existing knobs: --datasize-style per-test knobs, test-specific env vars
- [ ] mmap/madvise/THP availability on the host
- **Status:** pending

tests_set_base.add(

        # tests (vmovnt*, memcpy_variations_dyn) self-skip on non-aarch64 via
        # #ifdef __aarch64__ guards in init/run; the other 12 are arch-neutral
        # (std::memcpy / std::atomic / __sync_synchronize / portable inline asm).
        'memory/memcpy0.cpp',
        'memory/memcpy1.cpp',
        'memory/memcpy_l1d_size.cpp',
        'memory/memcpy_l2_cache_size.cpp',
        'memory/memcpy_l3_cache_size.cpp',

        # the ARM64 page-table-walker state machine via forced TLB misses
        # (madvise MADV_DONTNEED), cross-page-boundary accesses, unaligned
        # accesses and stride sweeps; detects silent MMU/translation
        # corruption via byte-exact golden compare. The run path is compiled
        # out under #ifdef __aarch64__ and returns a clean EXIT_SKIP on
        # non-aarch64 (x86-64 untouched).
        'memory/mmu_stress_arm.cpp',
        # Cache coherency / stress tests. cachebounce is portable (std::atomic);
        # cache_stress_aggressor uses ARM NEON under #ifdef __aarch64__ guards and
        # returns a clean EXIT_SKIP on non-aarch64 (x86-64 untouched).
        'cache/cachebounce.cpp',
        'cache/cache_stress_aggressor.cpp',
        # Load-port pressure test (ported from the reference tree). Uses NEON
        # 128-bit vld1q_u32/vst1q_u32 under #ifdef __aarch64__ and returns a
        # clean EXIT_SKIP ("to be implemented (placeholder): ARM NEON required")
        # on non-aarch64 (x86-64 untouched).
        'load_port/load_port.cpp',
    )
)

# MPSC memcpy coherence stress test (ARM64-only). Ported from a standalone
# GlusterFS-IOT-scheduler stress tool: producers route requests through a
# 4-priority linked-list queue (tests/cpu/memory/list.h, kernel-style) and
# consumers memcpy per-thread mem_info_s buffers, checking b1..b5 stay byte-
# identical (silent-data-corruption detection). Roles are assigned from CPU
# topology (device_info[cpu].numa_id/die_id/core_id) per a pluggable
# strategy config (tests/cpu/memory/strategy_config.h +
# memcpy_rewr_strategies.conf; cycle strategies via SANDSTONE_STRATEGY_INDEX,
# override path via SANDSTONE_STRATEGY_CONF). The arch-timer inline asm
# (mrs cntvct_el0/cntfrq_el0) has no x86 equivalent, so the test is built
# and registered only on aarch64 (x86-64 untouched). list.h and
# strategy_config.h are header-only and picked up via relative #include.
# MEMCPY_REWR_SRC_DIR is injected so the test can locate its default .conf
# beside the source at runtime regardless of the caller's CWD.
if host_machine.cpu_family() == 'aarch64'
    memcpy_rewr_dep = declare_dependency(
        compile_args : ['-DMEMCPY_REWR_SRC_DIR="' + meson.current_source_dir() + '/memory"'],
    )
    tests_set_base.add(
        when : memcpy_rewr_dep,
        if_true : files(
            'memory/memcpy_rewr.cpp',
        )
    )
endif

# Mesh/UPI inter-core traffic stress tests (27 tests, ported from the
# reference tree). These are REAL ARM NEON ports: all NEON intrinsics
# (vld1q_s32/vst1q_s32/vceqq_s32/etc.) are under #ifdef __aarch64__ with
# an #else path that returns EXIT_SKIP via log_skip(CpuNotSupportedSkipCategory,
# "to be implemented (placeholder): ARM NEON required for <test>") on
# non-aarch64. DECLARE_TEST is outside the guard so the test is registered
# on all arches and self-skips on x86-64 (no-op returning success is a bug).
# The _mm_/__m strings appearing in 12 files are comments (e.g. "类似
# _mm_sfence"), not real x86 intrinsics — verified 0 files have real x86 code.
# Test IDs inherit x86 AVX/SSE naming from the reference port but use NEON.
tests_set_base.add(
    files(
        'mesh/mesh_upi_avx_sym.cpp',
        'mesh/mesh_upi_avx2_asymm_distrib_int.cpp',
        'mesh/mesh_upi_avx2_asymm_distrib_write_int.cpp',

        'mesh/mesh_upi_avx512_asymm_read_only_int.cpp',
        'mesh/mesh_upi_avx512_asymm_write_int.cpp',
        'mesh/mesh_upi_avx512_asymm_write_only_int.cpp',

# Lock test suite (9 tests, std::atomic/std::atomic_flag-based, no x86

#    library with arch-optimised dispatch internally; the tests declare their
#    own extern "C" prototypes. Wired under the isal_lib gate below.
#  - 3 crc32* tests: ARM ACLE __crc32b/h/w intrinsics (<arm_acle.h>).

#    tests_crc_a static_library with -march=armv8.1-a+crc (see below). On

# OpenBLAS GEMM tests (vendored under third-party/openblas, built by its
# build.sh). Hand-written NEON fmla micro-kernels: the highest-density
# vector-FMA payload available, targeting the literature-confirmed #1 SDC
# source. The library is single-threaded (USE_THREAD=0) but must be built
# with USE_LOCKING=1 so the framework's one-worker-per-core threads can call
# cblas_dgemm concurrently: without it the internal packing-buffer pool
# (blas_memory_alloc) is a process-wide unlocked table and concurrent calls
# corrupt each other (empirically confirmed: 8 threads x 10s -> 62 byte
# mismatches; with USE_LOCKING=1: 128 cores (this machine, all cores) x 30s -> 0

# 【高优先级】122 号核心 SDC 故障狩猎任务（2026-09-19 记录）

> **优先级：高**。本文档是当前 `tests/cpu/sve/` 所有工作的任务纲领。

## 任务背景（用户 2026-09-19 设定）

这台机器的 **CPU 122 号核心存在 SDC 故障**（其余核心正常）。任务：写出**能快速找到 122 号 SDC** 的测试用例，并分析**什么负载可以快速触发它**。

## 强制验证流程（每次改写/新写测试用例时执行，顺序不可变）

1. **热插拔拔出 122**：将 CPU 122 offline（`echo 0 > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu122/online`）。
2. **干净基线跑 60s**：在**除 122 外的全部核心**上运行测试 60s。其他核心无 SDC 故障 → 逻辑正确的代码**必须全 pass 零 fail**；**出现任何 fail = 测试代码自身有逻辑缺陷**，必须定位并修改，不允许归咎于硬件。
3. **热插插回 122**：将 CPU 122 online（`echo 1 > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu122/online`）。
4. **全核心有效性验证**：在**含 122 的全部核心**上运行测试。只有 122 有 SDC → fail（若有）必须**精确锁定在 cpu 122**。这是测试用例有效性的判定标准。
5. 循环迭代：负载 → 122 是否被触发 → 分析什么负载特征触发最快。

## 核心判据

| 阶段 | 核心集合 | 期望结果 | 若不符 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 基线 60s | 全部 − {122} | 100% pass | **我的代码 bug**，修代码 |
| 有效性 | 全部（含 122） | fail 集中且仅出现在 cpu 122 | 测试无效或硬件故障表现变化，继续分析 |

## 任务目标

1. 写出能**快速检出** 122 号核心 SDC 的测试用例（放 `tests/cpu/sve/`，SVE 优先——本机 256-bit SVE + f32mm/f64mm/bf16/i8mm/fcma 实测可用，见 SVE 能力研究文档）。
2. 分析**什么负载特征**（指令类型/数据模式/访问序列）能最快触发该 SDC，形成负载特征分析结论。

## 待研究问题（开放）

- [ ] 122 号 SDC 的表现形态：错位翻转？哪个数据通路（INT/FP/SIMD/内存）？确定性还是概率性？
- [ ] 触发速度基线：现有测试（如 `sve512_f64_chain_arm`、`fma_tail_avx2`）能否触发？触发需要多久？
- [ ] SVE 专属负载 vs NEON 负载 vs 标量负载：哪类更快命中？
- [ ] 热插拔操作的具体机制（122 是否可 online/offline？sysfs 是否暴露？）
- [ ] SDCShield 的 `--cpuset` / `-n` / 日志 cpu-mask 字段用于精确归因到 122

## 相关文档

- [2026-09-18-sve-capability-research.md](2026-09-18-sve-capability-research.md) — 本机 SVE 能力实测 + golden 语义确认（FMMLA/BFDOT/SDOT/USMMLA/FCMLA）
- [2026-09-19-avx-named-tests-audit.md](2026-09-19-avx-named-tests-audit.md) — 53 个 avx 命名测试全无 SVE（NEON 128-bit 实现），覆盖缺口 = 本任务机会

# Task Plan: SDC Test Randomization Hardening (数值/地址空间变异加固)

## Goal
Audit all SDC detection tests for insufficient operand-value and address-space variation, identify hardening points, and produce an implementation plan for randomization hardening (value randomization + address-space coverage e.g. large malloc, offset randomization) that improves SDC detection coverage without breaking golden-value reproducibility.

## Next Step
Phase 1: enumerate all test groups and audit their operand/address-space variation characteristics (delegate parallel audit agents per test directory).

## Current Phase
Phase 1

## Phases

### Phase 1: Test Audit (operand/address-space variation census)
- [ ] Enumerate all test groups (arithmetic, fma, eigen_*, ipsec, zstd, zlib, sleef, openblas, pocketfft, isa-l, memory, cache, vector, sve, etc.)
- [ ] For each group: how are operands generated? (constant / fixed pattern / RNG per-thread / RNG per-run)
- [ ] For each group: how is memory allocated? (static / stack / fixed malloc / sized malloc; single buffer vs multiple; offset randomization?)
- [ ] Classify: which tests use random_input/randbits vs hardcoded constants
- [ ] Check memory tests (memory/, cache/) for address-space coverage strategy
- [ ] Document in findings.md (per-test table)
- **Status:** in_progress

### Phase 2: Framework capability survey
- [ ] RNG facilities: random_input/randbits/random.cpp APIs, per-thread state, re-seeding per iteration
- [ ] Memory allocation helpers: existing malloc wrappers, page-aligned alloc, hugepage support
- [ ] How golden-value comparison constrains randomization (memcmp reproducibility rule)
- [ ] Existing knobs: --datasize-style per-test knobs, test-specific env vars
- [ ] mmap/madvise/THP availability on the host
- **Status:** pending

1. **ipsec family (46 tests) — single frozen 1024 B plaintext per run.** The whole family shares one template: one `memset_random` 1024 B buffer + keys in init, then 256 iterations × all CPUs encrypt/decrypt/HMAC the *identical* bytes at *identical* addresses (3 fixed per-thread mallocs, zero offset/size variation). A defect that only manifests on specific operand values or addresses (e.g. a bit-line sensitive to one data pattern, or a physical-address-dependent fault) is exercised with exactly one sample per fork. Fix is cheap and **verification-compatible**: goldens are runtime-computed, so re-roll input + recompute golden every iteration (or every K), and/or add the openssl_sha-style random-offset arena. Note the family also never varies DATA_SIZE (1024u everywhere).
2. **openssl_sm3sm4 — single frozen plaintext, no offsets.** Same weakness as ipsec in a single test; explicitly documented in a comment as intentional ("no offsets needed"). Same compatible fix.
3. **openssl_sha / openssl_sha3 — frozen 1024/256-element golden pools.** Better than ipsec (random offset 1–512 B + random element selection per iteration) but the plaintext pool is generated once in init and never refreshed, and the run arena is only ~1.2 KB, so address-space coverage is a few cache lines. Only `isal_crc32_gzip` has a genuine independent software reference. Also: all use `std::mt19937`/`random_device` instead of the framework RNG, single fixed 1 KB buffer (no address variation), and the 4-byte store/reload "consistency check" is compiler-foldable noise. `crc32` and `crc32_fixed` are byte-identical duplicate tests.
5. **zpclmul / zpclmul_rep — placeholder "hardware" path.** `crc32_hardware()` returns the zlib software result; the single NEON `vaddq_u8` result is discarded. "hw==sw" is software==software. Detects only transient double-compute divergence. Needs a real NEON CRC-folding implementation before randomization matters.
6. **isal_igzip — input frozen after init.** Good dual verification (byte-identical re-compression + roundtrip), but the 256 KB mixed pattern/random buffer is built once; roundtrip verification makes per-iteration re-generation fully compatible (the golden stream could be recomputed or dropped in favor of roundtrip-only).
7. **zlib_aaa / zstd_aaa — constant 'a' input.** By design (compressible-data complement to the random variants); acceptable since siblings cover random operands.

## Strong patterns already in the repo (models to copy)

- **zlib/zstd/zfuzz random variants**: fresh buffer + fresh *size* per iteration + roundtrip verification — operand and address variation both strong, and the verification method imposes zero randomization constraints.
- **isal_crc32_gzip**: independent software reference recomputed per iteration from the same fresh data.

## Cross-cutting facts

- Framework RNG availability: `random32()/random64()/memset_random()` (framework/sandstone.h:571-578, per-thread state in framework/random.cpp). The crc/zpclmul family bypasses it with `std::mt19937`; openssl/ipsec/zlib/zstd use it.
- No test in the audited set uses precomputed golden *constants in source* — every golden is either runtime-computed at init (openssl*, ipsec, isal_igzip), a roundtrip, a same-function dual-check, or an independent software reference. Therefore **input randomization is verification-compatible across the entire audited set**; the only real constraint is cost (golden recompute ≈ doubles crypto work per iteration for the copy→compute→verify tests).
- Address-space variation techniques present in the repo today: random mmap offsets (openssl_sha/sha3 only), fresh varying-size mallocs (zlib/zstd/zfuzz), per-thread fixed scratch (everything else). No test uses large-arena + random-offset + size-variation combined.

A defect that only manifests on specific operand values or addresses (e.g. a bit-line sensitive to one data pattern, or a physical-address-dependent fault) is exercised with exactly one sample per fork. Fix is cheap and **verification-compatible**: goldens are runtime-computed, so re-roll input + recompute golden every iteration (or every K), and/or add the openssl_sha-style random-offset arena. Note the family also never varies DATA_SIZE (1024u everywhere).
2. **openssl_sm3sm4 — single frozen plaintext, no offsets.** Same weakness as ipsec in a single test; explicitly documented in a comment as intentional ("no offsets needed"). Same compatible fix.

Re-rolling elements periodically is compatible (runtime golden).
4. **crc32 dual-check family (crc32, crc32_fixed, crc32_fixed_shuffled, 9 isal_* variants) — no independent reference.** Operand variation is strong (fresh mt19937 data every iteration) but verification compares the hardware function *against itself* — a consistently-wrong CRC unit passes every time. 5. **zpclmul / zpclmul_rep — placeholder "hardware" path.** `crc32_hardware()` returns the zlib software result; the single NEON `vaddq_u8` result is discarded. "hw==sw" is software==software. 6. **isal_igzip — input frozen after init.** Good dual verification (byte-identical re-compression + roundtrip), but the 256 KB mixed pattern/random buffer is built once; roundtrip verification makes per-iteration re-generation fully compatible (the golden stream could be recomputed or dropped in favor of roundtrip-only).
7. **zlib_aaa / zstd_aaa — constant 'a' input.** By design (compressible-data complement to the random variants); acceptable since siblings cover random operands.

- **zlib/zstd/zfuzz random variants**: fresh buffer + fresh *size* per iteration + roundtrip verification — operand and address variation both strong, and the verification method imposes zero randomization constraints.
- **isal_crc32_gzip**: independent software reference recomputed per iteration from the same fresh data.

## Cross-cutting facts

- Framework RNG availability: `random32()/random64()/memset_random()` (framework/sandstone.h:571-578, per-thread state in framework/random.cpp). The crc/zpclmul family bypasses it with `std::mt19937`; openssl/ipsec/zlib/zstd use it.

- Address-space variation techniques present in the repo today: random mmap offsets (openssl_sha/sha3 only), fresh varying-size mallocs (zlib/zstd/zfuzz), per-thread fixed scratch (everything else). No test uses large-arena + random-offset + size-variation combined.

# SDCShield Randomization-Hardening Facility Survey

## 1. RNG facilities (`framework/random.cpp`, `framework/sandstone.h`, `framework/sandstone_p.h`)

### Public API (declared in `framework/sandstone.h:570-657`, implemented in `framework/random.cpp`)

| Function | Exact signature | Semantics |
|---|---|---|
| `random32` | `extern uint32_t random32(void)` | One 32-bit draw from the calling thread's engine |
| `random64` | `extern uint64_t random64(void)` | 64-bit draw. AES: one 128-bit AES round, low 64 lanes. LCG/generic: `generate32() \| (uint64_t(generate32()) << 32)` |
| `random128` | `extern __uint128_t random128(void)` | 128-bit draw (AES: one full `__m128i`/`uint8x16_t` round) |
| `frandomf_scale` | `extern float frandomf_scale(float scale)` | uniform in `[0, scale)`; mantissa from `generate32` (digits<=32) masked to mantissa width, divided by max integral |
| `frandom_scale` | `extern double frandom_scale(double scale)` | same, `generate64` for 53-bit mantissa |
| `frandoml_scale` | `extern long double frandoml_scale(long double scale)` | same (`long double` on aarch64 is quad — `digits > 64` uses `generate64`, so 113-bit quad mantissa is truncated to 64 bits of randomness) |
| `frandomf/frandom/frandoml` | `static inline ... frandomf()` etc. | scale = 1.0 wrappers |
| `memset_random` | `extern void *memset_random(void *dest, size_t n)` | fills buffer with random bytes: `random128()` blocks of 16 bytes, final partial block copies last 16 bytes overlapping the end (line 713-741). C++ overloads take `std::span`/`std::array`/`std::vector` |
| `set_random_bits` | `uint64_t set_random_bits(unsigned num_bits_to_set, uint32_t bitwidth)` | randomly chooses `num_bits_to_set` distinct bit positions out of `bitwidth` (Fisher-Yates via `random32() % remaining`); returns bitmask. Corner cases: `>=64 && bitwidth>=64` → all-ones |

Framework-internal (`framework/sandstone_p.h:657-661`):
- `void random_init_global(const char *argument)` — construct engine + seed global (index -1) state
- `void random_advance_seed()` — **implemented as just `rand();`** (random.cpp:648-651): draws one sample from the *global* (thread -1) engine, thereby perturbing the state from which all per-thread engines will next be seeded
- `std::string random_format_seed()` — `"Engine:state-string"` (e.g. `AES:aabbcc...`), used for logging and for passing the seed to exec'd children
- `void random_init_thread(int thread_num)` — seeds per-thread state from global state + topology mixin
- `uint32_t random_seed_low32()` — returns `rng_for_thread(-1)->u32[0]`, i.e. the low 32 bits of the *global* engine state (not per-thread)

The framework also **overrides libc** `rand`/`random`/`drand48`/`mrand48`/`lrand48`/`erand48`/`nrand48`/`jrand48`/`rand_r` to route to the framework engine, and makes `srand`/`srandom`/`srandom_r`/`srand48` **abort()**. `std::random_device` is also hooked (`random_device::_M_getval` → `random32()`). So any test using `std::random_device`, `rand()`, `Eigen::Random` etc. transparently gets the framework RNG.

### Per-thread state
- State is a `union alignas(64) thread_rng` of 64 bytes (random.cpp:57-67), stored in **`sApp->random_engine->per_thread` — a `std::vector<thread_rng>` of size `thread_count()+1`** (index 0 = global/main thread `-1`, index i+1 = thread i). It is *not* C++ `thread_local`; dispatch is via `thread_local_rng()` → `rng_for_thread(thread_num)` using the `__thread int thread_num` TLS variable. Each worker thread's state is private by construction (each thread only touches its own slot).
- `thread_runner` (framework/sandstone_run.cpp:738) calls `random_init_thread(thread_number)` at thread start, **before** `test_run`.

### Engines (random.cpp:74-85)
`enum EngineType { Constant = 0, LCG = 1, AESSequence = 3 }`
- **Constant**: `constant_value_engine` — returns the same value forever. `seedThread` = XOR mixin into the constant.
- **LCG**: `std::minstd_rand` (minimum standard, 31-bit). `generate32` consumes **two** samples, `generate64` consumes **three**. Specialized `seedThread`: per-thread engine seeded `global() ^ mixin` (global engine copied, not advanced).
- **AES** (x86 `#pragma GCC target("aes")`; aarch64 `#pragma GCC target("+crypto")` — `vaesmcq_u8(vaeseq_u8(state[0], state[1]))`): 2×128-bit state; each `generateM128` is one AES round. `haveAes()` on aarch64 uses `device_has_feature(cpu_feature_aes)` (HWCAP). AES `seedThread` is the *generic* version: `buffer->u32[i] = global->u32[i] ^ mixin` for all 16 words.

### Seeding / selection
- CLI: `-s <STATE>, --rng-state=<STATE>` (`sandstone_opts.cpp:166`, option char `'s'`) — form `Engine:engine-specific-data`, e.g. `AES:hex...` or `LCG:number`. `random_init_global(seed)`: if the argument names a readable file, 16 bytes are read from it as the seed (engine picked randomly: AES if `type&2`); otherwise parsed as `Engine:state`; if no `-s` at all → engine = LCG unless AES available and a random byte from `/dev/urandom` (or `AT_RANDOM`, 16 bytes) has bit 1 set → AES; the seed itself comes from `/dev/urandom`/`AT_RANDOM` (128 bits). There is **no `--random-seed <int>`** option; the seed is engine-state, not a plain integer.
- Default on this aarch64 host (AES-capable Kunpeng-class): random 50/50 between LCG and AES, random 128-bit seed.
- **`-s help` / `-s list`** prints available engines and exits.

| Function | Exact signature | Semantics |
|---|---|---|

| `random128` | `extern __uint128_t random128(void)` | 128-bit draw (AES: one full `__m128i`/`uint8x16_t` round) |
| `frandomf_scale` | `extern float frandomf_scale(float scale)` | uniform in `[0, scale)`; mantissa from `generate32` (digits<=32) masked to mantissa width, divided by max integral |
| `frandom_scale` | `extern double frandom_scale(double scale)` | same, `generate64` for 53-bit mantissa |
| `frandoml_scale` | `extern long double frandoml_scale(long double scale)` | same (`long double` on aarch64 is quad — `digits > 64` uses `generate64`, so 113-bit quad mantissa is truncated to 64 bits of randomness) |
| `frandomf/frandom/frandoml` | `static inline ... frandomf()` etc. | scale = 1.0 wrappers |
| `memset_random` | `extern void *memset_random(void *dest, size_t n)` | fills buffer with random bytes: `random128()` blocks of 16 bytes, final partial block copies last 16 bytes overlapping the end (line 713-741). C++ overloads take `std::span`/`std::array`/`std::vector` |
| `set_random_bits` | `uint64_t set_random_bits(unsigned num_bits_to_set, uint32_t bitwidth)` | randomly chooses `num_bits_to_set` distinct bit positions out of `bitwidth` (Fisher-Yates via `random32() % remaining`); returns bitmask. Corner cases: `>=64 && bitwidth>=64` → all-ones |

Any test whose golden value is computed *in the same run from the same stream* is fine; a hardcoded golden derived from a previous run is not reproducible across fractures.
  2. `mixin` depends on topology — golden data generated on one host may not reproduce on a differently-numbered topology (core_id/package_id differ).
  3. In `exec_each_test` mode the seed is explicitly re-passed to children, keeping them identical to the parent's state.
- Practical rule used by existing tests: generate the golden in `test_init` (main thread, its own stream) or compute golden from the operands within the same iteration — never hardcode RNG-derived constants.

## 2. Memory allocation facilities

### `aligned_alloc_safe` (framework/sandstone.h:555-568)
```c
static inline void *aligned_alloc_safe(size_t alignment, size_t size)
{
    extern void *aligned_alloc(size_t, size_t);
    if (alignment < sizeof(void*)) alignment = sizeof(void*);
    size_t aligned_size = (size / alignment) * alignment;
    if (aligned_size < size) aligned_size += alignment;
    return aligned_alloc(alignment, aligned_size);   // rounds size UP to a multiple of alignment
}
```
No framework wrapper for huge allocations, no mmap-with-THP helper, no malloc-size knob.

### mmap usage today (framework + tests, excluding third-party)
- **Framework**: `ManagedCodeBuffer` (framework/sandstone_test_utils.h:50-115) — RAII mmap wrapper (`allocate(size)`, `allocate_at` MAP_FIXED, `allocate_near`, `set_executable`, auto-munmap destructor). Intended for self-modifying code but is a general anonymous RW mmap helper. Also `ROUND_UP_TO_PAGE` macro in the same header. Thread-guard pages: framework/sandstone_thread.cpp:46-63 (`mmap PROT_NONE` + `MADV_GUARD_INSTALL`, kernel ≥ 6.13). `strerror_for_mmap()` (sandstone.h:510) for portable mmap error reporting. Windows compat layer `sysdeps/windows/mman.c` provides mmap/madvise on Windows. KVM selftests use `MAP_SHARED|MAP_ANONYMOUS` + `MADV_COLD` (sysdeps/linux/kvm.c).
- **Tests**: only `mmu_stress_arm.cpp` uses mmap+madvise directly (see §4). No test uses `MADV_HUGEPAGE` or hugetlbfs. No hugepage/THP references anywhere in framework/ or tests/ (grep verified).
- Tests otherwise use plain `malloc` (e.g. memcpy0.cpp `malloc(BLOCK_SIZE)`, mem_disambiguation.cpp) or `std::vector` (memcpy_l3_cache_size.cpp).

### SandstoneApplication data-size knobs — essentially none
Grep of `framework/sandstone_opts.cpp` for datasize/data_size/max_memory: **no such option exists**. The only memory-related options are deprecated no-ops: `--mem-sample-time`, `--mem-samples-per-log`, `--no-memory-sampling` (all land in the "deprecated options" case, opts.cpp:641-646). Existing relevant knobs:
- `-t <ms>`/`--timeout`, `--max-test-loop-count`, `-n/--threads`, `--cpuset`
- Per-test runtime knobs via **`-O/--test-option <test>.<key>=<value>`** (opts.cpp:181,459,951-954) read in tests with `get_testspecific_knob_value_{uint,int,double,string}(test, "key", default)` (framework/test_knobs.h). This is the established per-test size knob mechanism (used by `eigen_svd_cdouble_sve` as `-O eigen_svd_cdouble_sve.mdim=N`).
- `struct test` timing fields (sandstone.h:391-408): `desired_duration`, `minimum_duration` (ms), `fracture_loop_count`.

### Cache-size discovery — two mechanisms
1. **`sysconf(_SC_LEVEL{n}_{D,}CACHE_SIZE)`** — what the memcpy_* tests use (see §4). On this host glibc's getconf does not export them (`getconf LEVEL3_CACHE_SIZE` → 0 / unrecognized), and the tests fall back to hardcoded 8 MB — sysconf cache sizes are **not reliable here**.
2. **Framework API**: `device_info[thread].cache[0..2]` of type `struct cache_info_t { int cache_instruction; int cache_data; int16_t id; bool is_unified; }` (framework/device/cpu/cpu_device.h:149-203) — "value is the cache size in bytes; a field is valid if >= 0". Populated by topology.cpp from sysfs. **No test currently uses `device_info[].cache[]`** (grep over tests/ is empty) — it is available but unexercised.
3. Raw sysfs ground truth on this host: `/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cache/index{0..3}` → L1D 64K, L1I 64K, L2 1280K, L3 57344K (56 MB).

## 3. Golden-value comparison contract

### `memcmp_or_fail` / `report_fail` — per-THREAD abort, not whole-test
- C++ (sandstone.h:699-772): `template <ValidDataType T, ...> static inline void memcmp_or_fail(const T *actual, const T *expected, size_t count, [formatter|fmt,...])` — `__builtin_memcmp(actual, expected, count * sizeof(T))`; on mismatch calls `report()`/`_memcmp_fail_report()` which are `[[noreturn, cold]]`. `count` is **elements**, not bytes.
- Termination path: `report()` (sandstone_run.cpp:310-329) → `report_fail_common()` (178-191): marks the thread failed via `logging_mark_thread_failed(thread_num)`, then **`pthread_cancel(pthread_self())`** (ASYNCHRONOUS) — kills only the calling worker thread. The test as a whole fails when the parent aggregates thread states; other threads keep running until they finish/time out. If `--ud-on-failure` was given, `ud2()` executes first (crash instead).
- On mismatch the framework logs the **first differing byte offset** (`memcmp_offset`, linear scan) plus up to 256 bytes of context data (logging_report_mismatched_data), and runs the optional formatter callback at the failing index.
- `report_fail(test)` / `report_fail_msg(...)` macros (`_report_fail`/`_report_fail_msg`, noreturn) — same `report_fail_common()` path with a `file:line` log.
- `install_failure_callback(cb)` (sandstone.h:445): one-shot per-thread callback at first error, useful to dump test context.

### `TEST_LOOP(test, N)` (sandstone.h:138-148)
```c
#define TEST_LOOP(test, N)                          \
    static_assert(N > 0, "N must be positive");     \
    test_loop_start();                              \
    for (int _loop_i_ = 0; _loop_i_ == 0; test_loop_end(), _loop_i_ = 1)          \
        for ( ; _loop_i_ < N || (_loop_i_ = 0, test_loop_condition(N)); ++_loop_i_)
```
Body runs N times per granularity batch, then `test_loop_condition(N)` (sandstone_run.cpp:584-591) checks (a) optional injected idle `usleep(current_test_sleep_duration/N)`, then `test_time_condition()` (572-582): increments `inner_loop_count`, ends if `max_loop_count_exceeded()` or the **wallclock deadline** `sApp->shmem->current_test_endtime` has expired. So iterations continue until time budget or loop cap — a test with large per-iteration cost should instead use `do {...} while (test_time_condition(test));` (as the memory tests do) or set `desired_duration` so exactly one iteration runs (as svd_cdouble_sve does). `TEST_LOOP` N is conventionally a power of two.

### SNaN quieting (framework/sandstone_data.cpp)
Software FP16/BF16 conversions quiet signaling NaNs so bit patterns are identical cross-arch (x86 FPU quiets SNaN in hardware; AArch64 does not):
- `ieee754_downconvert` (to FP16), line 50-58: on Inf/NaN input (`exp == max`), if mantissa nonzero → `mant |= 1 << (Float16::digits - 2)` (set the FP16 quiet bit) — comment explicitly cites SDC golden-value comparisons.
- `to_bfloat16`, line 104-111: NaN input → `r |= 1 << (BFloat16::digits - 2)`.
- `fromfp16_emulated` (decode), line 157-160: NaN → sets float quiet bit `p |= 1 << (Float16::digits - 2)` before widening.
These are in the *conversion helpers* only (`tofp16_emulated`, `tobf16_emulated`); a test doing raw double/float SIMD compares must still ensure its own data avoids arch-divergent NaN production (or mask NaNs before compare).

## 4. Existing large-buffer test precedents (patterns to copy)

### `tests/cpu/memory/memcpy_l3_cache_size.cpp` — sysconf cache-size pattern
- Sizes buffer via `get_l3_size()`: `sysconf(_SC_LEVEL3_CACHE_SIZE)`, fallback `8 MB` (lines 11-16); `static const size_t BLOCK_SIZE = get_l3_size();` (init-time constant). Siblings do the same for L1D (`_SC_LEVEL1_DCACHE_SIZE`) and L2.
- Allocation **inside `test_run`, per thread**: `std::vector<uint8_t> src(BLOCK_SIZE); dst(BLOCK_SIZE);` — freed automatically at function exit each... actually they live for the whole run function scope.
- Random operands: `std::mt19937 rng(std::random_device{}())` per thread — note `random_device` is hooked to `random32()`, so this is the framework RNG with a `mt19937` re-mix; golden is *self-computed per iteration* (`memcpy` then `memcmp` dst vs src), so reproducibility is inherent.
- Loop: `do { fill; memcpy; memcmp; } while (test_time_condition(test));`
- Weaknesses visible for hardening: `sysconf(_SC_LEVEL3_CACHE_SIZE)` returns 0/unsupported on this host → always the 8 MB fallback while real L3 is 56 MB; fills byte-by-byte via `dist(rng)` (slow); per-iteration `store_buf` vector alloc; prints to stderr every iteration.

### `tests/cpu/memory/mmu_stress_arm.cpp` — mmap + MADV_DONTNEED sweep pattern
- Fixed `NUM_PAGES = 4096` (16 MB at 4K pages, comment justifies: ~64× typical DTLB), per-thread private `mmap(nullptr, region_size, PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0)` in `test_run`; `EXIT_SKIP` on MAP_FAILED.
- Per page: `madvise(page, page_size, MADV_DONTNEED)` (forces fault + page-table-walk replay) → read-back-must-be-zero → store golden → read-back-verify; plus cross-page-boundary 8-byte access at `page_end-4` and unaligned accesses at offsets 1-3; then a full-region DTLB-thrash sweep (write pass + verify pass, per-page golden `GOLDEN_TABLE[p%6] ^ (p*0x9E3779B97F4A7C15)`).
- Golden values are **deterministic functions of the page index** (high-Hamming-weight table + per-page XOR) — no RNG involvement, so byte-exact compare is trivially reproducible. Values are NOT randomized (hardening opportunity).
- `munmap` before both fail (`report_fail_msg`) and success exits.
- Anti-pattern documented in its own comments: a single shared region failed under multithreading (concurrent DONTNEED racing golden-read) → always per-thread regions.

### `tests/cpu/eigen_svd/svd_cdouble_sve.cpp` — available-memory sizing pattern
- `size_matrix()` (lines 87-110): `sysconf(_SC_PHYS_PAGES) * sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE) / thread_count()` = RAM per worker; knob `-O eigen_svd_cdouble_sve.mdim=N` (clamped [300,6000]) takes precedence; otherwise `N = min(sqrt(ram_per_worker / (12.0 * 16.0)), 4400)` — 12× measured RSS/matrix ratio (20% headroom over measured ~9.7-10×), 16 bytes per complex<double> element, floored at 300 and time-capped at 4400 (10-min budget, measured `t(N) ≈ 243.4 s·(N/4400)³ + 1 s`).
- Decision made **once in `test_preinit`** (runs in the parent before durations are computed — the only place writing `test->desired_duration` is effective for the first run) so timing scales with dimension: `desired_duration = iter_s*950 ms` → exactly one iteration at every dimension.
- Random operands: `Mat::Random(g_dim, g_dim)` (Eigen) in init, golden BDCSVD computed in init from the same matrix; run re-computes and memcmp-compares — the golden-vs-actual use of RNG is self-consistent in one execution.

## 5. Host capabilities (measured on this machine)

| Probe | Result |
|---|---|
| `grep -i huge /proc/meminfo` | `HugePages_Total: 0`, `Hugepagesize: 2048 kB` (no pre-allocated hugetlb pages); `AnonHugePages: 14336 kB` in use; `FileHugePages: 1024000 kB` |
| THP mode | `/sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled` = `[always] madvise never` — **THP=always**, so MADV_HUGEPAGE is unnecessary (all anon mappings already THP-eligible); defrag = `[madvise]` |
| `ulimit -v` / `ulimit -m` | both `unlimited` |
| `nproc` / CPUs | 127 online (machine is 128 CPUs, 1 offline); `getconf _NPROCESSORS_CONF` = 127 |
| `free -g` | total 61 GB, free 38 GB, available 52 GB, swap 31 GB |
| Kernel | `6.6.0-159.4.3.154.oe2403sp4.aarch64` (openEuler 24.03 SP3) — kernel 6.6: MADV_HUGEPAGE/MADV_DONTNEED/MADV_COLD (5.4+) all present; MADV_GUARD_INSTALL needs 6.13 → not available here (framework already guards this) |
| Page size | 4096 bytes (no base-page other than 4K) |
| Cache (sysfs, cpu0) | L1D 64K, L1I 64K, L2 1280K, L3 57344K |
| `sysconf(_SC_LEVEL*_CACHE_SIZE)` | **unavailable** (getconf returns "Unrecognized variable" / 0) → memcpy_l{1d,2,3} tests run on their hardcoded 8 MB/… fallbacks here |

### Key implications for the hardening plan
1. Randomized operands are cheap and reproducible **if golden is computed in the same execution** (init or per-iteration) from the same per-thread stream; cross-fracture/cross-host reproduction of RNG-derived hardcoded goldens is NOT guaranteed (global seed advances per fracture; mixin is topology-dependent).
2. Large allocations: plain malloc/mmap up to ~52 GB available, `ulimit -v` unlimited; with THP=always a large `mmap(MAP_ANONYMOUS|MAP_PRIVATE)` region is automatically THP-backed — `MADV_HUGEPAGE` adds nothing on this host but is harmless and correct for portability. Precedent sizing: per-worker = `_SC_PHYS_PAGES*_SC_PAGESIZE/thread_count()` (svd_cdouble_sve) with a measured RSS multiplier + headroom.
3. Per-test size knobs already have a first-class mechanism (`-O test.key=value` + `get_testspecific_knob_value_*`); a generic `--datasize` does not exist and adding one would be new framework surface.
4. Failure semantics are per-thread `pthread_cancel`; large per-thread allocations must be freed by `test_cleanup`/RAII since a cancelled thread won't run cleanup code after the cancel point.
5. Cache-size detection via sysconf is broken on this host; either read `/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cache/index*/size` or use `device_info[].cache[]` (framework-populated, currently unused by tests).

## Top weaknesses (ranked for the "malloc 大内存 + address randomization" hardening goal)

1. **No test combines large malloc with randomized offsets.** Address-space coverage splits into two disjoint camps: large-but-fixed buffers (memcpy_l3_cache_size, mesh read_only 4 MB, memcpy_rewr multi-MB, mmu_stress_arm 16 MB mmap) vs small-but-random (mfence/atomic_seq_cst 32 KB random index, mem_disambiguation 4 KB, part_store_fwd_jit 8-byte window). **Only `lockgen` does random indexing into an 8 MB array** — that pattern (large malloc + per-iter random address + golden per-cell) is the template to generalize. Prime hardening targets: memcpy_l1d/l2/l3 (allocate N MB pool, random src/dst offsets per iteration), vmovnt* (move off 64 B stack onto an MB pool with random offset), load_port, modified_sort.
2. **Operand value space is tiny in several PROD tests**: `atomic_simd_*` (5 tests) use only all-0/all-1; `memcpy0` all-zero; `cache_stress_aggressor` sequential float ramp; `mmu_stress_arm` 6-entry pattern table (address side is strong, value side weak); vmovnt2/2_vex use ±10⁴/±10⁶ narrow integer ranges instead of full 64-bit random. Hamming-distance coverage beyond "all bits flip" is essentially absent in the atomic family.
3. **Verification holes (worse than weak variation)**:
   - `cache_stress_aggressor`: victim thread computes pass/fail but **never reports failure** — SDC in the victim value is silently ignored.

   - lock/spinlock family (≈20 tests): aggregate Σ check only at test end — a transiently corrupted counter read that doesn't affect the final sum is undetected; no per-operation read-back.

# Findings: SDC 测试随机化加固审计（Phase 1 + Phase 2 完成）

日期：2026-09-19。方法：5 路并行审计代理（compute / memory-lock / crypto-compression / arm64-native / framework），全部基于真实源码阅读 + 本机实测。

## 0. 全局结论（三句话）

1. **操作数变异**：全仓库没有一个大类做到了"每迭代重掷操作数 + 每迭代重算 golden"。绝大多数测试在 `test_init` 随机一次后冻结整场；一批测试（ipsec 46 个、sm3sm4、power_virus_dit、fpu_special_values、sve chain 系列、fisttp_arm、bigint_mulx_arm、adcx）连"每次运行"的随机都没有（固定明文/固定表/固定种子 12345）。
2. **地址空间变异**：全仓库没有一个测试同时具备"大 malloc + 随机偏移 + 尺寸变化"。两极分化：要么大而固定（memcpy_l3 8MB 回退值、mmu_stress 16MB、sve *_svd 23.7MB），要么小而随机（mfence/atomic_seq_cst 32KB 随机索引、part_store_fwd_jit 8 字节窗口）。唯一的大地址空间随机访问测试是 `lockgen`（8MB 随机索引，但只有聚合校验）。
3. **框架能力完全够用**：`random32/64/128`、`frandom*`、`memset_random`、`set_random_bits` 都是按线程独立流（AES 引擎本机可用）；`-O test.key=value` knob 机制现成；THP=always、ulimit 无限、52GB 可用内存；`device_info[].cache[]` 框架已填充但零测试使用（且 sysconf cache size 在本机坏掉，memcpy_l* 全部落到硬编码回退值）。

## 1. 分级审计表（按 SDC 漏检风险排序）

### T0 — 立即加固（fixed-seed / 固定明文 / 验证漏洞）

| 测试 | 问题 | 修复难度 |
|---|---|---|
| `arithmetic/adcx.cpp` | **mt19937_64(12345) 固定种子**，init 一次，所有机器所有运行的操作数字节完全相同 | 极低：改用框架 random64() |
| `ipsec_*`（46 个测试，同一模板） | **单个 1024B memset_random 明文冻结整场**；DATA_SIZE=1024 全家族不变；3 个固定 malloc 零偏移；golden 是 init 运行时算的 → **每 K 迭代重掷 + 重算 golden 完全兼容** | 中：改一个模板 46 个测试全受益 |
| `openssl_sm3sm4` | 单个 1024B 明文冻结整场，注释明说"不需要偏移" | 低 |
| `cache/cache_stress_aggressor.cpp` | **验证漏洞**：victim 线程算出 pass/fail 但从不 report —— SDC 被静默吞掉 | 极低 |
| `openssl_sha`/`openssl_sha3` | golden 池（1024/256 元素）init 冻结；run 竞技场仅 ~1.2KB（几条 cache line） | 低 |
| `zpclmul`/`zpclmul_rep` | "硬件路径"是假的（调 zlib 软件 crc32，NEON vaddq 结果被丢弃）→ hw==sw 是软件==软件 | 中：需真 NEON CRC folding |
| `virtualization/vmx_*`（ARM64 路径）+ `jit/zero_control_vec_*`（ARM64） | 单次 0xDEADBEEF 栈存取即 return EXIT_SUCCESS —— **违反仓库自己的 placeholder-honesty 规则**（应 EXIT_SKIP） | 低 |
| `vmx_io_exit`（x86 路径） | inb 读回值只打印不比较 | 低 |

### T1 — 大类加固（"init 随机一次冻结整场"模式）

| 家族 | 操作数 | 地址 | 关键事实 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fma/`（12 个） | MODERATE（mt19937 每迭代重掷，但区间窄 ±10~±1e6，用 std 引擎绕开框架 RNG） | WEAK（100~450B 栈，永远同一地址） | fma.cpp / fma_patterns_* 是 **容差比较 1e-6/1e-15，会吞掉 1-ULP 翻转**；fmatail_* 兄弟已是 memcmp，不一致 |
| `gather/`（10 个） | MODERATE（每迭代重掷 src+indices） | WEAK（4-24KB 固定栈） | **hw 和 ref 是同一段标量代码跑两遍**（gather_f32.cpp:36-47）—— 没有真 gather 指令在热点路径上 |
| `eigen_*`（16 个） | MODERATE（Mat::Random init 一次冻结；Eigen rand 走框架覆盖的 rand()） | WEAK（固定 768KB~4.3MB；唯一例外 svd_cdouble_sve 尺寸随内存） | 多分钟运行锤同一批字节 |
| `arithmetic_arm/` GMP 系列（4 个） | gmp_bignum/bigadd：**一对 4096-bit 操作数跑整场**；fisttp_arm/bigint_mulx_arm 固定种子 | WEAK（≤150KB 固定） | adcx_*_arm 用 random_device（被框架 hook）算正常 |
| `arm64/` NEON 系列（agu_stress_2src、neon_rot_2src、neon_add、arm_crypto、movbe 家族、mrn_* 家族） | MODERATE（memset_random init 一次冻结） | WEAK（4-64KB 固定，整场同地址） | golden 大多 init 在**同一 NEON 单元**上算出（自一致性，抓不住 init 与 run 同错的确定性缺陷）；例外：movbe_dump_probe_e 有 NUMA mbind，g1/h 有 256KB 步长 LLC 压力 |
| `sve512_*` 系列（8 个） | **WEAK**：F32_FINITE/F64_FINITE 16 元素表按 `(i*7+1)%16` 取，无随机；gather_scatter 是 VL 个种子复制 | arm 变体 WEAK（64KB）；svd 变体 STRONG（23.7MB 块遍历） | svd 变体**每迭代重算标量 golden** —— 这是全仓库唯一"每迭代重算 golden"的家族，是值加固的现成模板 |
| `memory/memcpy_l{1d,2,3}` | MODERATE（mt19937 每迭代重填） | WEAK（**sysconf 在本机返回 0 → 永远 8MB 回退值**，真实 L3 是 56MB；单固定 buffer 对） | 本机 sysfs 真值：L1D 64K / L2 1280K / L3 57344K |
| `atomic_simd_128/256/512` | **WEAK**：只测 all-0x00 / all-0xFF 两个值 | WEAK（固定地址） | Hamming 距离覆盖只有"全翻转" |
| `memory/vmovnt*`（6 个） | MODERATE-（区间窄：float ±1、i32 ±1e4、i64 ±1e6，非全 64 位） | WEAK（≤128B 栈） | |
| `lock/`+`spinlock/`（~20 个） | MODERATE | WEAK（1-2 条 cache line；lockgen 例外 8MB 随机索引） | **聚合 Σ 校验**：中途读坏但终和不变 → 漏检；mesh 家族同为求和校验（抵消性错误通过） |

### T2 — 已达标的正面模板（hardening 时照抄）

| 测试 | 值得抄什么 |
|---|---|
| `openblas_{d,s,z,c}gemm` + `lu` | copy-in 污染缓存 → 计算 → **字节精确 memcmp 输入+乘积**；mdim knob 16..4096 扫 L1→DRAM；transab/beta 操作数路径 knob；per-thread scratch |
| `sleef_neon` | 域映射随机数 + nelems knob 24KB→2MB 扫缓存层级 + u10/u35 双独立多项式链 |
| `pocketfft_fft` | n knob 白名单（2^n / 素数 Bluestein / 5-smooth → 3 条不同代码路径）+ 字节精确正向 + 往返容差反向 |
| `zlib/zstd/zfuzz` 随机变体 | **每迭代新鲜 buffer + 新鲜尺寸（4KB-32MB）+ 往返校验** —— 全仓库最接近理想的模式 |
| `sve512_*_svd` 变体 | 每迭代重算标量 golden + 大块遍历 |
| `lockgen` | 8MB 随机索引（大地址空间随机访问的唯一现存实例） |
| `mmu_split_tlb_arm` | 32MB TLB 压力 + memfd 8 路 VA 别名 |
| `isal_crc32_gzip` | 唯一有独立软件参考的 CRC 测试（本地逐位 CRC vs isa-l） |
| `eigen_svd_cdouble_sve` | 按可用内存定尺寸：`_SC_PHYS_PAGES*_SC_PAGESIZE/thread_count()`，实测 RSS 倍率×12 余量，knob 优先 |

## 2. 框架能力清单（Phase 2）

### RNG（全部就绪，按线程独立）
- `random32()/random64()/random128()`、`frandomf_scale/frandom_scale/frandoml_scale`、`memset_random`（16B 块填）、`set_random_bits`（Fisher-Yates 随机位）— framework/sandstone.h:570-657
- 引擎：Constant / LCG / AES（本机 AES 可用，默认 50/50 LCG/AES + 128bit 随机种子）；`-s Engine:state` 可复现
- **按线程分流**：`random_init_thread(num)` 用 topology mixin（core_id/package_id/thread_id&3 的 pattern XOR）→ 不同核不同流，同 -s 种子同拓扑可复现
- libc `rand`/`random`/`random_device` 全被框架接管（所以 mt19937{random_device{}} 实际是框架 RNG 的再混合）；`srand/srandom` 会 abort
- **fracture 语义**：`run_one_test_inner` 每次 fracture 后 `random_advance_seed()` → 跨 fracture 操作数会变；golden 必须同场同流算出，不能跨场硬编码
- **golden 复现铁律**（现状已验证）：本仓库所有 crypto/compression golden 都是运行时算的（init copy→compute 或往返），没有一个源码内硬编码 golden 常量 → **输入随机化与校验方法全仓库兼容，唯一代价是 golden 重算的算力翻倍**

### 内存/knob
- `aligned_alloc_safe`（向上取整对齐）；无现成 mmap/THP 助手，但 `ManagedCodeBuffer`（sandstone_test_utils.h:50-115）是现成 RAII mmap 封装可参考
- **per-test knob 机制现成**：`-O test.key=value` + `get_testspecific_knob_value_{uint,int,double,string}`（framework/test_knobs.h）— eigen_svd_cdouble_sve 的 mdim 就是这么做的
- **cache 尺寸 API**：`device_info[thread].cache[0..2]`（字节，sysfs 填充，负数=无效）已填充但**零测试使用**；sysconf(_SC_LEVEL*_CACHE_SIZE) 本机返回 0（memcpy_l* 全部落回退值）→ 应改用 device_info 或直读 sysfs
- 失败语义：`memcmp_or_fail` → `pthread_cancel` 只杀当线程；大分配必须 test_cleanup/RAII 释放（cancel 后不会跑到清理点）

### 本机能力（实测）
- THP=always（MADV_HUGEPAGE 冗余但可移植性正确）；HugePages_Total=0（显式 hugetlb 不可用）；ulimit -v/-m 无限
- 61GB 总内存 / 52GB available / 127 核在线（1 个 offline）；内核 6.6（MADV_GUARD_INSTALL 需 6.13 不可用）
- 页 4KB；真实缓存：L1D 64K / L2 1280K / L3 57344K

## 3. 加固点清单（Phase 3 — 按性价比排序）

每项 = 一个 patch 单元（CLAUDE.md one-patch-per-unit）。

| # | 加固点 | 技术 | 作用对象 | 兼容性 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| H1 | **adcx 固定种子 12345 → 框架 random64()** | 值 | 1 测试 | 零风险（golden init 同场算） |
| H2 | **cache_stress_aggressor 验证漏洞修复**（fail 必须 report_fail） | 校验 | 1 测试 | 零风险 |
| H3 | **vmx_*/zero_control_vec_* ARM64 假 pass → EXIT_SKIP**（诚实性） | 校验 | ~11 测试 | 零风险 |
| H4 | **fma.cpp/fma_patterns_* 容差 → 字节精确 memcmp**（对齐 fmatail_* 兄弟） | 校验 | 3 测试 | 需确认 NEON vfmaq 与 libm fma 位一致（fmatail 已证明可行） |
| H5 | **公共大内存随机访问测试 `random_access_sweep`（新）**：N MB mmap（默认 min(512MB, avail/threads)），随机偏移块读写 + 每块 CRC golden，THP 天然生效，knob 控尺寸 | 值+地址 | 新测试 | 抄 lockgen（随机索引）+ mmu_stress（mmap）+ zlib（每迭代新鲜） |
| H6 | **ipsec 模板：每 K 迭代重掷明文+密钥+重算 golden**（K=1 或按时间预算） | 值+地址 | 46 测试改一个模板 | golden 运行时算，兼容；加密算力×2 可接受（本来就是压测） |
| H7 | **openssl_sha/sha3/sm3sm4：golden 池周期重填 + run 竞技场扩到 KB-MB 级随机偏移** | 值+地址 | 3 测试 | 同 H6 |
| H8 | **memcpy_l{1d,2,3} 修尺寸探测**（device_info[].cache[] 或 sysfs 直读，本机 8MB→56MB）+ 每迭代随机 src/dst 偏移 | 地址 | 3 测试 | sysconf 回退值是 bug 级问题 |
| H9 | **fma/vector/gather 家族迁到框架 RNG + 每迭代随机偏移窗口**（栈→大缓冲内滑动窗口） | 值+地址 | ~28 测试 | memcmp 已字节精确 |
| H10 | **atomic_simd_*：all-0/all-1 → memset_random** | 值 | 3-5 测试 | 零风险 |
| H11 | **eigen_*：每迭代（或每 K）重掷矩阵+重算 golden**（抄 sve512_*_svd 的每迭代重算模式；注意 eigen_svd 的多线程 ULP 已知问题 → 保持 -n 1 语义或每线程独立矩阵） | 值 | 16 测试 | 大矩阵重算贵 → K 按预算调 |
| H12 | **sve512_*_chain_arm：16 元素固定表 → 框架随机填充（保 specials 比例）** | 值 | 4-8 测试 | golden 每迭代算，兼容 |
| H13 | **GMP 系列：一对操作数跑整场 → 每迭代新对** | 值 | 2-4 测试 | mpz golden init 算，重掷需重算（init 内循环化） |
| H14 | **spinlock/lock/mesh 聚合 Σ → 每-op 读回校验**（或抽查校验） | 校验 | ~25 测试 | 改动面大，放最后 |
| H15 | **crc 家族独立参考**（抄 isal_crc32_gzip 的逐位软件参考，替换自比较） | 校验 | ~12 测试 | 参考实现每迭代算 |

## 4. 风险与约束

- **golden 复现**：任何随机化都必须"同场同流"算 golden（init 或每迭代）。禁止把 RNG 派生的 golden 写进源码。fracture 间种子会前进 — 这是特性不是 bug（每次 fracture 换操作数）。
- **Eigen 多线程 ULP 已知问题**（CLAUDE.md）：H11 需保持每线程独立矩阵/独立 golden，或维持 -n 1 语义。
- **122 号核心两阶段验证**（memory/cpu122-sdc-hunt-mission.md）：所有新/改测试必须走 offline 122 → 60s 全 pass 基线 → online 122 → fail 精确锁定 122 的流程。H5 新测试尤其如此。
- **算力预算**：每迭代重算 golden ≈ 计算×2（copy→compute→compare 本来就是双算）；ipsec 46 个测试 ×2 加密算力在 60s 预算内可接受（本来就是压力测试）。
- **stderr 刷屏**：fma/vector/gather 家族每迭代 fprintf 严重拖慢迭代速率（192 核时尤甚）— 顺手在 H9 中一并修（降为失败时才输出）。
- **x86-64 不触碰**：所有改动必须 `#elif __aarch64__` / 共享代码加宽 / 或对 x86 语义无影响的公共路径。

# Findings & Decisions

## Requirements
- User: 当前 SDC 检测用例最大的问题是对**操作数（数值）**或**地址空间**的变异不够 → 需要尽可能对数值和地址空间做比较好的随机（例如 malloc 大内存等），识别加固点，制订方案。
- 本任务是审计+方案设计（识别加固点、制订方案），不是立即实施。
- 必须走 planning-with-files（本文件即工作记忆）。
- 上下文：122 号 CPU 有 SDC 故障（memory/cpu122-sdc-hunt-mission.md）——随机化加固最终要服务"在 122 上能暴露故障"的目标。

## Prior audits (2026-09-18, DO NOT redo — different axis)
- `docs/SDC_TEST_AUDIT_REPORT_2026-09-18.md`: 11 defect classes (D1-D11) — **verification-logic** axis (false-pass, same-source golden, tolerance too wide). NOT about operand/address variation.
- `docs/SDC_LIBRARY_STRESS_COVERAGE_AUDIT_2026-09-18.md`: library stress coverage — linking/kernel-reach/golden-independence axis.
- Prior audits noted (relevant hint): "重复同一调用" patterns mean fixed inputs; eigen/openblas/sleef init-run same-call = input constant across iterations.
- This audit's axis is NEW: **operand value variation × address-space variation per test** (working-set size, buffer placement, offset/alignment randomization, re-roll cadence).

## Test inventory (301 files, ~308 unique test IDs)
Directories (test dirs only, excluding gpu/idxd/examples):
- arithmetic (x86 adcx/adox), arithmetic_arm (adcx_arm, gmp_*, acl_gemm, operand_space_arm, crt_builtins, fisttp_arm)
- arm-0102 (arm0102_kreg_mask), arm64 (39 tests: movbe, neon_rot, sdc_test, sve512_* 8 files, ooo_dep_chain, lsu/l2c/mmu/agu, power_virus_dit, crypto_test, etc.)
- atomic (6), cache (cachebounce, cache_stress_aggressor), crc (13), eigen_gemm (8), eigen_sparse (1), eigen_svd (7), eigen_svd_jacobi (4)
- fma (11), gather (9), ifs (2+unit), ipsec (46), isa-l (igzip), ist (1), jit (7), load_port (1)
- lock (5), memory (22: memcpy*, mem_disambiguation, mfence*, mmu_stress_arm, modified_sort, vmovnt*), mesh (26), misc (16)
- openblas_gemm (5), openssl (3), pocketfft (1), sleef (2), spinlock (19), vector (13), virtualization (9 vmx), zlib (2), zstd (1)

### 0. 全局结论（三句话）

### 4. 框架能力清单（Phase 2）

## Goal
Audit all SDC detection tests for insufficient operand-value and address-space variation, identify hardening points, and produce an implementation plan for randomization hardening (value randomization + address-space coverage e.g. large malloc, offset randomization) that improves SDC detection coverage without breaking golden-value reproducibility.

## Next Step
Phase 1: enumerate all test groups and audit their operand/address-space variation characteristics (delegate parallel audit agents per test directory).

## Current Phase
Phase 1

# Findings & Decisions

## Requirements
- User: 当前 SDC 检测用例最大的问题是对**操作数（数值）**或**地址空间**的变异不够 → 需要尽可能对数值和地址空间做比较好的随机（例如 malloc 大内存等），识别加固点，制订方案。
- 本任务是审计+方案设计（识别加固点、制订方案），不是立即实施。
- 必须走 planning-with-files（本文件即工作记忆）。
- 上下文：122 号 CPU 有 SDC 故障（memory/cpu122-sdc-hunt-mission.md）——随机化加固最终要服务"在 122 上能暴露故障"的目标。

## Prior audits (2026-09-18, DO NOT redo — different axis)
- `docs/SDC_TEST_AUDIT_REPORT_2026-09-18.md`: 11 defect classes (D1-D11) — **verification-logic** axis (false-pass, same-source golden, tolerance too wide). NOT about operand/address variation.
- `docs/SDC_LIBRARY_STRESS_COVERAGE_AUDIT_2026-09-18.md`: library stress coverage — linking/kernel-reach/golden-independence axis.
- Prior audits noted (relevant hint): "重复同一调用" patterns mean fixed inputs; eigen/openblas/sleef init-run same-call = input constant across iterations.
- This audit's axis is NEW: **operand value variation × address-space variation per test** (working-set size, buffer placement, offset/alignment randomization, re-roll cadence).

## Test inventory (301 files, ~308 unique test IDs)
Directories (test dirs only, excluding gpu/idxd/examples):
- arithmetic (x86 adcx/adox), arithmetic_arm (adcx_arm, gmp_*, acl_gemm, operand_space_arm, crt_builtins, fisttp_arm)
- arm-0102 (arm0102_kreg_mask), arm64 (39 tests: movbe, neon_rot, sdc_test, sve512_* 8 files, ooo_dep_chain, lsu/l2c/mmu/agu, power_virus_dit, crypto_test, etc.)
- atomic (6), cache (cachebounce, cache_stress_aggressor), crc (13), eigen_gemm (8), eigen_sparse (1), eigen_svd (7), eigen_svd_jacobi (4)
- fma (11), gather (9), ifs (2+unit), ipsec (46), isa-l (igzip), ist (1), jit (7), load_port (1)
- lock (5), memory (22: memcpy*, mem_disambiguation, mfence*, mmu_stress_arm, modified_sort, vmovnt*), mesh (26), misc (16)
- openblas_gemm (5), openssl (3), pocketfft (1), sleef (2), spinlock (19), vector (13), virtualization (9 vmx), zlib (2), zstd (1)
- common: mce_check, smi_count

## 122-CPU SDC hunt context (drives design constraints)
- CPU 122 is the single faulty core; mission = tests that quickly expose it + analyze what load features trigger fastest (docs/docs_xu/2026-09-19-cpu122-sdc-hunt-mission.md).
- Mandatory 2-phase validation for every new/changed test: offline 122 → 60s all-others-pass baseline (any fail = test-code bug) → online 122 → fail must pin to cpu 122.
- Implication for randomization hardening: hardened tests MUST be deterministic-clean on healthy cores (no flaky RNG-induced false fails; re-rolled data needs golden recomputed in-loop from the same per-thread RNG stream, or verification must be input-independent) — a 192-core clean-baseline run is the gate.
- Unknowns still open: which datapath (INT/FP/SIMD/mem) the 122 fault lives in → value+address randomization breadth is exactly the tool to map it.

## Research Findings (2026-09-19, 5 路并行审计完成：compute / memory-lock / crypto-compression / arm64-native / framework，全部基于真实源码阅读 + 本机实测)

### 0. 全局结论（三句话）
1. **操作数变异**：全仓库没有一个大类做到"每迭代重掷操作数 + 每迭代重算 golden"。绝大多数测试 `test_init` 随机一次后冻结整场；一批测试（ipsec 46 个、sm3sm4、power_virus_dit、fpu_special_values、sve chain 系列、fisttp_arm、bigint_mulx_arm、adcx）连"每次运行"的随机都没有（固定明文/固定表/固定种子 12345）。
2. **地址空间变异**：全仓库没有一个测试同时具备"大 malloc + 随机偏移 + 尺寸变化"。两极分化：要么大而固定（memcpy_l3 8MB 回退值、mmu_stress 16MB、sve *_svd 23.7MB），要么小而随机（mfence/atomic_seq_cst 32KB 随机索引、part_store_fwd_jit 8 字节窗口）。唯一的大地址空间随机访问测试是 `lockgen`（8MB 随机索引，但只有聚合校验）。
3. **框架能力完全够用**：`random32/64/128`、`frandom*`、`memset_random`、`set_random_bits` 按线程独立流（AES 引擎本机可用）；`-O test.key=value` knob 机制现成；THP=always、ulimit 无限、52GB 可用；`device_info[].cache[]` 框架已填充但零测试使用（且 sysconf cache size 本机坏掉，memcpy_l* 全部落硬编码回退值 8MB，真实 L3=56MB）。

### 1. T0 — 立即加固（固定种子/固定明文/验证漏洞）
| 测试 | 问题 | 修复难度 |
|---|---|---|
| `arithmetic/adcx.cpp` | **mt19937_64(12345) 固定种子**，init 一次 → 所有机器所有运行操作数字节完全相同 | 极低（改框架 random64） |
| `ipsec_*`（46 个，同一模板） | **单个 1024B 明文冻结整场**；DATA_SIZE=1024 全家族不变；3 固定 malloc 零偏移；golden 是 init 运行时算 → 每 K 迭代重掷+重算 golden 完全兼容 | 中（改一模板 46 测试受益） |
| `openssl_sm3sm4` | 单 1024B 明文冻结整场 | 低 |
| `cache/cache_stress_aggressor.cpp` | **验证漏洞：victim 算出 pass/fail 但从不 report —— SDC 被静默吞掉** | 极低 |
| `openssl_sha`/`sha3` | golden 池（1024/256 元素）init 冻结；run 竞技场仅 ~1.2KB | 低 |
| `zpclmul`/`zpclmul_rep` | "硬件路径"是假的（zlib 软件 crc32；NEON vaddq 结果被丢弃）| 中 |
| `vmx_*`（ARM64 路径）+ `jit/zero_control_vec_*`（ARM64） | 单次 0xDEADBEEF 栈存取即 EXIT_SUCCESS —— **违反仓库 placeholder-honesty 规则（应 EXIT_SKIP）**；x86 的 vmx_io_exit inb 读回值只打印不比较 | 低 |

### 2. T1 — 大类加固（"init 随机一次冻结整场"模式）
| 家族 | 操作数 | 地址 | 关键事实 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fma/`（12） | MODERATE（mt19937 每迭代重掷但区间窄 ±10~±1e6） | WEAK（100~450B 栈，永远同一地址） | fma.cpp/fma_patterns_* **容差比较 1e-6/1e-15 吞 1-ULP 翻转**；fmatail_* 兄弟已 memcmp，不一致 |
| `gather/`（10） | MODERATE（每迭代重掷 src+indices） | WEAK（4-24KB 固定栈） | **hw 与 ref 是同一段标量代码跑两遍**（gather_f32.cpp:36-47）——热点无真 gather 指令 |

| `memory/memcpy_l{1d,2,3}` | MODERATE（mt19937 每迭代重填） | WEAK（**sysconf 本机返回 0 → 永远 8MB 回退值**，真实 L3 56MB；单固定 buffer 对） | 本机 sysfs 真值：L1D 64K/L2 1280K/L3 57344K |
| `atomic_simd_128/256/512` | **WEAK：只测 all-0x00/all-0xFF** | WEAK（固定地址） | Hamming 覆盖只有"全翻转" |
| `memory/vmovnt*`（6） | MODERATE-（区间窄：float ±1、i32 ±1e4、i64 ±1e6） | WEAK（≤128B 栈） | |
| `lock/`+`spinlock/`+`mesh/`（~45） | MODERATE | WEAK（1-2 cache line；lockgen 例外 8MB 随机索引） | **聚合 Σ 校验：中途读坏但终和不变 → 漏检；mesh 抵消性错误通过** |

| `openblas_{d,s,z,c}gemm`+`lu` | copy-in 污染缓存→计算→**字节精确 memcmp 输入+乘积**；mdim knob 16..4096 扫 L1→DRAM；transab/beta 路径 knob |
| `sleef_neon` | 域映射随机数 + nelems knob 24KB→2MB + u10/u35 双独立链 |
| `pocketfft_fft` | n knob 白名单（2^n/素数 Bluestein/5-smooth→3 条代码路径）+ 字节精确正向 + 往返容差反向 |
| `zlib/zstd/zfuzz` 随机变体 | **每迭代新鲜 buffer+新鲜尺寸（4KB-32MB）+往返校验** —— 最接近理想 |
| `sve512_*_svd` | 每迭代重算标量 golden + 大块遍历 |
| `lockgen` | 8MB 随机索引（唯一大地址空间随机访问实例） |
| `mmu_split_tlb_arm` | 32MB TLB 压力 + memfd 8 路 VA 别名 |
| `isal_crc32_gzip` | 唯一有独立软件参考的 CRC（本地逐位 vs isa-l） |
| `eigen_svd_cdouble_sve` | 按可用内存定尺寸 `_SC_PHYS_PAGES*_SC_PAGESIZE/thread_count()`，实测 RSS 倍率×12 余量，knob 优先 |

### 4. 框架能力清单（Phase 2）
**RNG（就绪，按线程独立流）**：
- `random32()/random64()/random128()`、`frandomf_scale/frandom_scale/frandoml_scale`、`memset_random`（16B 块）、`set_random_bits` — framework/sandstone.h:570-657
- 引擎 Constant/LCG/AES（本机 AES 可用，默认 50/50 + 128bit 随机种子）；`-s Engine:state` 可复现
- 按线程分流：`random_init_thread(num)` topology mixin（core_id/package_id/thread_id&3 pattern XOR）→ 不同核不同流，同种子同拓扑可复现
- libc `rand/random/random_device` 全被框架接管（mt19937{random_device{}} 实为框架 RNG 再混合）；`srand/srandom` abort
- fracture 语义：每次 fracture 后 `random_advance_seed()` → 跨 fracture 操作数会变；golden 必须同场同流算出
- **golden 复现铁律（已验证）**：本仓库所有 crypto/compression golden 都是运行时算的，无一源码硬编码 golden → **输入随机化与校验方法全仓库兼容，唯一代价是 golden 重算算力翻倍**

**内存/knob**：
- `aligned_alloc_safe`（向上取整对齐）；无现成 mmap/THP 助手，`ManagedCodeBuffer`（sandstone_test_utils.h:50-115）是 RAII mmap 参考实现
- **per-test knob 现成**：`-O test.key=value` + `get_testspecific_knob_value_{uint,int,double,string}`（framework/test_knobs.h）
- **cache 尺寸 API**：`device_info[thread].cache[0..2]`（字节，sysfs 填充，负数=无效）已填充但零测试使用；sysconf 本机返回 0 → 应改用 device_info 或直读 sysfs
- 失败语义：`memcmp_or_fail` → `pthread_cancel` 只杀当线程；大分配必须 test_cleanup/RAII 释放

**本机（实测）**：THP=always（MADV_HUGEPAGE 冗余但可移植）；HugePages_Total=0；ulimit -v/-m 无限；61GB 总/52GB avail/127 核在线；内核 6.6（MADV_GUARD_INSTALL 需 6.13 不可用）；页 4KB；L1D 64K/L2 1280K/L3 57344K

### 5. 加固点清单（Phase 3 — 按性价比排序，每项 = 一个 patch 单元）
| # | 加固点 | 技术 | 作用对象 | 兼容性 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| H1 | adcx 固定种子 12345 → 框架 random64() | 值 | 1 测试 | 零风险（golden init 同场算） |
| H2 | cache_stress_aggressor 验证漏洞修复（fail 必须 report_fail） | 校验 | 1 测试 | 零风险 |

| H4 | fma.cpp/fma_patterns_* 容差 → 字节精确 memcmp（对齐 fmatail_*） | 校验 | 3 测试 | 需确认 NEON vfmaq 与 libm 位一致（fmatail 已证明可行） |
| H5 | **公共大内存随机访问测试 random_access_sweep（新）**：N MB mmap（默认 min(512MB, avail/threads)），随机偏移块读写+每块 CRC golden，knob 控尺寸 | 值+地址 | 新测试 | 抄 lockgen+mmu_stress+zlib；**走 122 两阶段验证** |

### 6. 风险与约束
- **golden 复现**：随机化必须"同场同流"算 golden（init 或每迭代）；禁止 RNG 派生 golden 硬编码进源码。fracture 间种子前进是特性（每次 fracture 换操作数）。
- **干净基线门**（122 任务）：加固后测试在健康核上必须确定性全 pass——重掷数据的 golden 必须同循环内从同一线程流重算，或校验输入无关。192 核 60s 基线是门。
- **Eigen 多线程 ULP 已知问题**（CLAUDE.md）：H11 需每线程独立矩阵/独立 golden 或维持 -n 1 语义。
- **算力预算**：每迭代重算 golden ≈ 计算×2（copy→compute→compare 本就是双算）；ipsec 46×2 在 60s 预算内可接受。
- **stderr 刷屏**：fma/vector/gather 每迭代 fprintf 严重拖慢迭代速率（192 核尤甚）——H9 顺带修。
- **x86-64 不触碰**：所有改动 `#elif __aarch64__` / 共享代码加宽 / 对 x86 语义无影响的公共路径。

+3. **框架能力完全够用**：`random32/64/128`、`frandom*`、`memset_random`、`set_random_bits` 按线程独立流（AES 引擎本机可用）；`-O test.key=value` knob 机制现成；THP=always、ulimit 无限、52GB 可用；`device_info[].cache[]` 框架已填充但零测试使用（且 sysconf cache size 本机坏掉，memcpy_l* 全部落硬编码回退值 8MB，真实 L3=56MB）。
+### 1. T0 — 立即加固（固定种子/固定明文/验证漏洞）
+| 测试 | 问题 | 修复难度 |
+| `arithmetic/adcx.cpp` | **mt19937_64(12345) 固定种子**，init 一次 → 所有机器所有运行操作数字节完全相同 | 极低（改框架 random64） |
+| `ipsec_*`（46 个，同一模板） | **单个 1024B 明文冻结整场**；DATA_SIZE=1024 全家族不变；3 固定 malloc 零偏移；golden 是 init 运行时算 → 每 K 迭代重掷+重算 golden 完全兼容 | 中（改一模板 46 测试受益） |
+| `openssl_sm3sm4` | 单 1024B 明文冻结整场 | 低 |
+| `cache/cache_stress_aggressor.cpp` | **验证漏洞：victim 算出 pass/fail 但从不 report —— SDC 被静默吞掉** | 极低 |
+| `openssl_sha`/`sha3` | golden 池（1024/256 元素）init 冻结；run 竞技场仅 ~1.2KB | 低 |
+| `zpclmul`/`zpclmul_rep` | "硬件路径"是假的（zlib 软件 crc32；NEON vaddq 结果被丢弃）| 中 |
+| `vmx_*`（ARM64 路径）+ `jit/zero_control_vec_*`（ARM64） | 单次 0xDEADBEEF 栈存取即 EXIT_SUCCESS —— **违反仓库 placeholder-honesty 规则（应 EXIT_SKIP）**；x86 的 vmx_io_exit inb 读回值只打印不比较 | 低 |
+### 2. T1 — 大类加固（"init 随机一次冻结整场"模式）
+| 家族 | 操作数 | 地址 | 关键事实 |
+| `fma/`（12） | MODERATE（mt19937 每迭代重掷但区间窄 ±10~±1e6） | WEAK（100~450B 栈，永远同一地址） | fma.cpp/fma_patterns_* **容差比较 1e-6/1e-15 吞 1-ULP 翻转**；fmatail_* 兄弟已 memcmp，不一致 |
+| `gather/`（10） | MODERATE（每迭代重掷 src+indices） | WEAK（4-24KB 固定栈） | **hw 与 ref 是同一段标量代码跑两遍**（gather_f32.cpp:36-47）——热点无真 gather 指令 |
+| `eigen_*`（16） | MODERATE（Mat::Random init 一次冻结） | WEAK（固定 768KB~4.3MB；唯一例外 svd_cdouble_sve 尺寸随内存） | 多分钟运行锤同一批字节 |
+| GMP 系列（gmp_bignum/bigadd 等） | **一对 4096-bit 操作数跑整场**；fisttp_arm/bigint_mulx_arm 固定种子 | WEAK（≤150KB 固定） | |

+| `arm64/` NEON 系列（agu_stress_2src、neon_rot_2src、neon_add、arm_crypto、movbe 家族、mrn_* 家族） | MODERATE（memset_random init 一次冻结） | WEAK（4-64KB 固定，整场同地址） | golden 大多 init 在**同一 NEON 单元**算出（自一致，抓不住 init/run 同错的确定性缺陷）；例外：movbe_dump_probe_e NUMA mbind、g1/h 256KB 步长 |
+| `sve512_*`（8） | **WEAK：F32/F64_FINITE 16 元素表按 (i*7+1)%16 取，无随机**；gather_scatter 是 VL 个种子复制 | arm 变体 WEAK（64KB）；svd 变体 STRONG（23.7MB 块遍历） | svd 变体**每迭代重算标量 golden** —— 全仓库唯一，是值加固现成模板 |
+| `memory/memcpy_l{1d,2,3}` | MODERATE（mt19937 每迭代重填） | WEAK（**sysconf 本机返回 0 → 永远 8MB 回退值**，真实 L3 56MB；单固定 buffer 对） | 本机 sysfs 真值：L1D 64K/L2 1280K/L3 57344K |
+| `atomic_simd_128/256/512` | **WEAK：只测 all-0x00/all-0xFF** | WEAK（固定地址） | Hamming 覆盖只有"全翻转" |
+| `memory/vmovnt*`（6） | MODERATE-（区间窄：float ±1、i32 ±1e4、i64 ±1e6） | WEAK（≤128B 栈） | |
+| `lock/`+`spinlock/`+`mesh/`（~45） | MODERATE | WEAK（1-2 cache line；lockgen 例外 8MB 随机索引） | **聚合 Σ 校验：中途读坏但终和不变 → 漏检；mesh 抵消性错误通过** |
+### 3. T2 — 正面模板（加固时照抄）
+| 测试 | 抄什么 |
+| `openblas_{d,s,z,c}gemm`+`lu` | copy-in 污染缓存→计算→**字节精确 memcmp 输入+乘积**；mdim knob 16..4096 扫 L1→DRAM；transab/beta 路径 knob |
+| `sleef_neon` | 域映射随机数 + nelems knob 24KB→2MB + u10/u35 双独立链 |
+| `pocketfft_fft` | n knob 白名单（2^n/素数 Bluestein/5-smooth→3 条代码路径）+ 字节精确正向 + 往返容差反向 |
+| `zlib/zstd/zfuzz` 随机变体 | **每迭代新鲜 buffer+新鲜尺寸（4KB-32MB）+往返校验** —— 最接近理想 |
+| `sve512_*_svd` | 每迭代重算标量 golden + 大块遍历 |
+| `lockgen` | 8MB 随机索引（唯一大地址空间随机访问实例） |
+| `mmu_split_tlb_arm` | 32MB TLB 压力 + memfd 8 路 VA 别名 |
+| `isal_crc32_gzip` | 唯一有独立软件参考的 CRC（本地逐位 vs isa-l） |
+| `eigen_svd_cdouble_sve` | 按可用内存定尺寸 `_SC_PHYS_PAGES*_SC_PAGESIZE/thread_count()`，实测 RSS 倍率×12 余量，knob 优先 |
+### 4. 框架能力清单（Phase 2）
+**RNG（就绪，按线程独立流）**：
+- `random32()/random64()/random128()`、`frandomf_scale/frandom_scale/frandoml_scale`、`memset_random`（16B 块）、`set_random_bits` — framework/sandstone.h:570-657
+- 引擎 Constant/LCG/AES（本机 AES 可用，默认 50/50 + 128bit 随机种子）；`-s Engine:state` 可复现
+- 按线程分流：`random_init_thread(num)` topology mixin（core_id/package_id/thread_id&3 pattern XOR）→ 不同核不同流，同种子同拓扑可复现
+- libc `rand/random/random_device` 全被框架接管（mt19937{random_device{}} 实为框架 RNG 再混合）；`srand/srandom` abort
+- fracture 语义：每次 fracture 后 `random_advance_seed()` → 跨 fracture 操作数会变；golden 必须同场同流算出
+- **golden 复现铁律（已验证）**：本仓库所有 crypto/compression golden 都是运行时算的，无一源码硬编码 golden → **输入随机化与校验方法全仓库兼容，唯一代价是 golden 重算算力翻倍**
+**内存/knob**：
+- `aligned_alloc_safe`（向上取整对齐）；无现成 mmap/THP 助手，`ManagedCodeBuffer`（sandstone_test_utils.h:50-115）是 RAII mmap 参考实现
+- **per-test knob 现成**：`-O test.key=value` + `get_testspecific_knob_value_{uint,int,double,string}`（framework/test_knobs.h）
+- **cache 尺寸 API**：`device_info[thread].cache[0..2]`（字节，sysfs 填充，负数=无效）已填充但零测试使用；sysconf 本机返回 0 → 应改用 device_info 或直读 sysfs
+- 失败语义：`memcmp_or_fail` → `pthread_cancel` 只杀当线程；大分配必须 test_cleanup/RAII 释放
+**本机（实测）**：THP=always（MADV_HUGEPAGE 冗余但可移植）；HugePages_Total=0；ulimit -v/-m 无限；61GB 总/52GB avail/127 核在线；内核 6.6（MADV_GUARD_INSTALL 需 6.13 不可用）；页 4KB；L1D 64K/L2 1280K/L3 57344K
+### 5. 加固点清单（Phase 3 — 按性价比排序，每项 = 一个 patch 单元）
+| # | 加固点 | 技术 | 作用对象 | 兼容性 |
+| H1 | adcx 固定种子 12345 → 框架 random64() | 值 | 1 测试 | 零风险（golden init 同场算） |
+| H2 | cache_stress_aggressor 验证漏洞修复（fail 必须 report_fail） | 校验 | 1 测试 | 零风险 |
+| H3 | vmx_*/zero_control_vec_* ARM64 假 pass → EXIT_SKIP（诚实性）+ x86 vmx_io_exit inb 读回比较 | 校验 | ~11 测试 | 零风险 |
+| H4 | fma.cpp/fma_patterns_* 容差 → 字节精确 memcmp（对齐 fmatail_*） | 校验 | 3 测试 | 需确认 NEON vfmaq 与 libm 位一致（fmatail 已证明可行） |
+| H5 | **公共大内存随机访问测试 random_access_sweep（新）**：N MB mmap（默认 min(512MB, avail/threads)），随机偏移块读写+每块 CRC golden，knob 控尺寸 | 值+地址 | 新测试 | 抄 lockgen+mmu_stress+zlib；**走 122 两阶段验证** |
+| H6 | ipsec 模板：每 K 迭代重掷明文+密钥+重算 golden | 值+地址 | 46 测试改一模板 | golden 运行时算，兼容；算力×2 可接受 |
+| H7 | openssl_sha/sha3/sm3sm4：golden 池周期重填 + run 竞技场扩 KB-MB 级随机偏移 | 值+地址 | 3 测试 | 同 H6 |
+| H8 | memcpy_l{1d,2,3} 修尺寸探测（device_info[].cache[]/sysfs，本机 8MB→56MB）+ 每迭代随机 src/dst 偏移 | 地址 | 3 测试 | sysconf 回退值是 bug 级 |
+| H9 | fma/vector/gather 家族迁框架 RNG + 每迭代随机偏移窗口（栈→大缓冲滑动窗口）；顺手修 stderr 每迭代刷屏 | 值+地址 | ~28 测试 | memcmp 已字节精确 |
+| H10 | atomic_simd_*：all-0/all-1 → memset_random | 值 | 3-5 测试 | 零风险 |
+| H11 | eigen_*：每 K 迭代重掷矩阵+重算 golden（抄 sve512_*_svd；每线程独立矩阵避开多线程 ULP 已知问题） | 值 | 16 测试 | 大矩阵重算贵 → K 按预算调 |
+| H12 | sve512_*_chain_arm：16 元素固定表 → 框架随机填充（保 specials 比例） | 值 | 4-8 测试 | golden 每迭代算，兼容 |
+| H13 | GMP 系列：一对操作数跑整场 → 每迭代新对 | 值 | 2-4 测试 | mpz golden 需 init 内循环化 |
+| H14 | spinlock/lock/mesh 聚合 Σ → 每-op 读回校验（或抽查） | 校验 | ~25 测试 | 改动面大，放最后 |
+| H15 | crc 家族独立软件参考（抄 isal_crc32_gzip，替换自比较） | 校验 | ~12 测试 | 参考每迭代算 |
+### 6. 风险与约束
+- **golden 复现**：随机化必须"同场同流"算 golden（init 或每迭代）；禁止 RNG 派生 golden 硬编码进源码。fracture 间种子前进是特性（每次 fracture 换操作数）。
+- **干净基线门**（122 任务）：加固后测试在健康核上必须确定性全 pass——重掷数据的 golden 必须同循环内从同一线程流重算，或校验输入无关。192 核 60s 基线是门。
+- **Eigen 多线程 ULP 已知问题**（CLAUDE.md）：H11 需每线程独立矩阵/独立 golden 或维持 -n 1 语义。
+- **算力预算**：每迭代重算 golden ≈ 计算×2（copy→compute→compare 本就是双算）；ipsec 46×2 在 60s 预算内可接受。
+- **stderr 刷屏**：fma/vector/gather 每迭代 fprintf 严重拖慢迭代速率（192 核尤甚）——H9 顺带修。
+- **x86-64 不触碰**：所有改动 `#elif __aarch64__` / 共享代码加宽 / 对 x86 语义无影响的公共路径。
## Technical Decisions
| Decision | Rationale |
+| 优先级 H1-H5 先行 | H1-H4 是零/低风险 bug 级修复；H5 是唯一新测试，直接服务 122 狩猎 |
+| ipsec 改模板不改 46 个文件 | 单模板单 patch，46 测试同时受益 |
+| 用框架 RNG（random64/memset_random）替换 mt19937 | 按线程独立流 + -s 可复现 + 已有 AES 引擎；mt19937{random_device{}} 虽被 hook 但语义间接 |
## Issues Encountered
| Issue | Resolution |
## Resources
-- framework/sandstone.h:573 `random64()`, :611 `set_random_bits(num_bits, bitwidth)` — RNG API surface
-- tests/cpu/arm64/operand_space_arm.cpp + tests/cpu/arithmetic_arm/operand_space_arm.cpp + memory/mmu_stress_arm.cpp — existing operand/address-space stress tests (name matches user's concern!)
+- framework/sandstone.h:570-657 RNG API；framework/test_knobs.h knob API

# Task Plan: SDC Test Randomization Hardening (数值/地址空间变异加固)

## Goal
Audit all SDC detection tests for insufficient operand-value and address-space variation, identify hardening points, and produce an implementation plan for randomization hardening (value randomization + address-space coverage e.g. large malloc, offset randomization) that improves SDC detection coverage without breaking golden-value reproducibility.

## Next Step
Phase 5: write the final plan doc to docs/superpowers/plans/ and present to user.

## Current Phase
Phase 5 (Delivery)

## Phases

### Phase 1: Test Audit (operand/address-space variation census)
- [x] Enumerate all test groups (301 files, ~308 test IDs across 30 dirs)
- [x] For each group: how are operands generated? (constant / fixed pattern / RNG per-thread / RNG per-run)
- [x] For each group: how is memory allocated? (static / stack / fixed malloc / sized malloc; single buffer vs multiple; offset randomization?)
- [x] Classify: which tests use random_input/randbits vs hardcoded constants
- [x] Check memory tests (memory/, cache/) for address-space coverage strategy
- [x] Document in findings.md (per-test table)
- **Status:** complete (2026-09-19, 4 parallel audit agents)

### Phase 2: Framework capability survey
- [x] RNG facilities: random32/64/128, frandom*, memset_random, set_random_bits — per-thread streams, AES engine, -s reproducibility, fracture semantics
- [x] Memory allocation helpers: aligned_alloc_safe, ManagedCodeBuffer (RAII mmap), no THP helper needed (THP=always on host)
- [x] How golden-value comparison constrains randomization: all goldens runtime-computed (no source-hardcoded golden constants) → randomization fully compatible; golden must be same-run same-stream
- [x] Existing knobs: -O test.key=value + get_testspecific_knob_value_* (test_knobs.h); no generic --datasize
- [x] mmap/madvise/THP availability on the host: THP=always, ulimit unlimited, 52GB avail, kernel 6.6, device_info[].cache[] populated-but-unused, sysconf cache size broken (returns 0)
- **Status:** complete (2026-09-19, framework survey agent + host probes)

### Phase 3: Gap analysis & hardening-point identification
- [x] Rank tests by (fixed operands, fixed addresses, small working set) — T0/T1/T2 classification in findings.md
- [x] For each hardening point: which randomization technique applies — H1..H15 table in findings.md
- [x] Identify tests where randomization breaks golden values: none (all goldens runtime-computed); constraint is only golden-recompute cost
- [x] Cross-reference 122-CPU SDC hunt mission context: clean-baseline gate + two-phase validation applies to all hardened/new tests
- **Status:** complete

### Phase 4: Plan formulation
- [x] Design common randomization helpers (if framework-level) vs per-test changes → decided: per-test changes using existing framework RNG + knobs; ONE new test (random_access_sweep); NO new framework surface
- [x] One-patch-per-unit decomposition matching CLAUDE.md patch discipline → P1..P17 units in final plan doc
- [x] Verification strategy per unit (build + run + regression + x86 non-regression + 122 two-phase for new tests)
- [x] Write final plan doc to docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-19-sdc-randomization-hardening.md
